Full summary: Merge integrator delivered: foundation/v3 = 92093f8c (all five lanes merged, contracts draft.3, correctionFor conflicts, gitignore, offline switch, matrix rebuilt), 179 files / 2674 passed / 0 failed, pushed to origin (PR #49). Tokenizer calibration table produced; wiring dispatched.
Decisions: Accepted the merge integrator's resolutions: both lanes' commands and lane 03's mirrorAll wrapper kept (41 commands / 25 full-surface / 16 default re-pinned); the `events` CLI word goes to lane 03's live-log reader on `twining` while `twining-mcp events` keeps lane 02c's database-free rollback reader and reports STORE_ROLLED_BACK naming the other; admission honours a prior admitted verdict in the replica's own admission log so a later policy cannot re-answer the bootstrap question (monotonic in time); adapters cite the current policy event (EventStore.currentPolicyEvent) so mirrored writes are never quarantined no_policy_yet on a store that ran the ceremony.; plugin/BEHAVIORS.md left stale on purpose (says 35 tools, omits the new ones): editing plugin/ forces a version bump + bundle rebuild, which is release work under Dave's authority — recorded as an owner item, not silently done.
Findings: Merge exposed four defects no lane suite could see: (1) rebuild() re-answered the bootstrap question after a policy existed and quarantined an entire migrated corpus (45→5 projections); (2) production: no adapter path cited the membership, so on any store that ran the ceremony EVERY mirrored 2.x write would have been quarantined and never projected; (3) the ceremony minted rulings its own store quarantined; (4) a literal NUL byte in src/retrieval/select.ts (caught by lane 02c's byte guard). All fixed with tests; 65 lane-04 fixture failures fixed in the fixtures via citeParents()/deliverUnderPolicy(), not by relaxing the rule.; Open after merge: baseline gaps 5 (remote staleness, no owner) and 8 (file-wins precedence, Dave's named design decision) still reproduce; C28 and C15's Codex half UNAVAILABLE; C07/C13/C23 have no executable case test; rebuild() re-journals with ingress hard-coded to import (harmless today, a trap for ingress-keyed rules); dev-scale trial not yet run (R20 benefit half, R14 recall-quality half open).; Tokenizer calibration ran successfully after the whitespace-document fix (src/retrieval/calibration.json, 607 bytes, envelope_overhead_tokens 8) but tokenizer.ts does not load it yet — wiring with proven-bound fallback dispatched.
